title: Direct evidence of Neanderthal fibre technology and its cognitive and behavioral implications
lineage: Paraphrased research notes, not a source copy.

passages.note: The authors report a tiny three-ply cord fragment adhering to a flake from level 4.2; separate contextual age estimates are 41±2, 46±5 and 52±2 thousand years. They interpret the fibres as inner bark of a gymnosperm, probably conifer.
